name: akmon
description: Rewrites text you give it so it reads naturally, and paraphrases it in a chosen style. You pick the mode; check remaining words anytime.

interface.longDescription:
Akmon rewrites text you already have so it reads naturally. Sign in with your Akmon account to use it.

- Humanize text: rewrites stiff or formulaic text so it reads like a person wrote it, keeping the meaning, facts, language and formatting. You choose the mode: Deep rewrite, Academic Deep Rewrite, Sentence Precise or Academic Precise (the sentence modes work with English and Korean text). Text needs at least 100 words.
- Paraphrase text: rewords text in the style you choose: Standard, Fluency, Formal, Academic, Simple or Creative. Korean text also supports Casual Enhanced, Academic Enhanced and Personal Statement.
- Account status: shows how many words you have left this month.

Akmon asks which mode you want before it processes anything. If you have not named one, it shows the list and nothing is used until you pick. It works on text you provide; it does not write new content, translate or summarize. Only the text you ask it to rewrite is sent to Akmon, and you see the result right away. Many languages are supported and detected automatically. You can disconnect anytime in Akmon under Connected apps.

Help: https://akmon.app/support/
Privacy: https://akmon.app/privacy/
Terms: https://akmon.app/terms/
defaultPrompt: Humanize this text with Akmon: [paste your text]
Paraphrase this with Akmon in a formal style: [paste your text]
How many Akmon words do I have left?

positive.description: Mode menu: no mode named. The assistant must ask which mode (or relay the tool's mode menu) and nothing is processed or charged.
positive.prompt:
Humanize this text with Akmon:

Remote work has become increasingly prevalent in recent years, and it is important to note that it offers numerous benefits for both employees and employers. Firstly, it eliminates the need for a daily commute, which saves a significant amount of time and money. Secondly, it provides greater flexibility, allowing individuals to organize their schedules in a manner that suits their personal needs. Furthermore, companies can access a wider talent pool, as geographical boundaries are no longer a limiting factor. However, it is also essential to acknowledge that remote work presents certain challenges, such as reduced face-to-face interaction and difficulties in maintaining a clear separation between professional and personal life. In conclusion, organizations should carefully evaluate both the advantages and the drawbacks before adopting a remote-first approach.
positive.expected_behavior: No mode was named, so no rewrite happens yet. The assistant asks which mode to use, or humanize_text is called without a mode and returns a 'Which Akmon mode?' list (Deep rewrite, Academic Deep Rewrite, Sentence Precise, Academic Precise) with the note that nothing was processed and no words were used. The assistant shows the options and waits for the user's choice. After the user replies 'Sentence Precise', humanize_text returns the rewritten text followed by a 'Mode: Sentence Precise' line and the words left this month.

positive.prompt:
Use Akmon to humanize this paragraph in Deep rewrite mode:

Firstly, it eliminates the need for a daily commute, which saves a significant amount of time and money. Secondly, it provides greater flexibility, allowing individuals to organize their schedules in a manner that suits their personal needs. positive.expected_behavior: humanize_text runs with mode deep_rewrite. The assistant shows the rewritten paragraph (same meaning and language) followed by a 'Mode: Deep rewrite' line and the words left this month. No mode menu is shown.

positive.prompt:
Paraphrase this email in a formal style with Akmon:

Hello Mr. Carter, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to let you know that the delivery of the new office chairs has been moved to next Thursday because of a delay at the warehouse. Please tell me if that date does not work for you, and I will try to arrange another one. Thanks a lot for your patience, and sorry for the trouble.
positive.expected_behavior: paraphrase_text runs with mode formal. The assistant shows the reworded email in a professional tone, same meaning, followed by a 'Mode: Formal' line and the words left this month.

positive.prompt:
Reword this abstract in an academic style using Akmon:

Previous studies on urban green spaces have shown that access to parks is linked to lower stress levels among residents. This paper looks at how the size and the distance of a park change that effect in mid-sized cities. We collected survey answers from 1,200 residents and compared them with local land-use data. The results show that distance matters more than size, and that the effect is stronger for people who work long hours.
positive.expected_behavior: paraphrase_text runs with mode academic. The assistant shows the reworded abstract with its facts and numbers unchanged, followed by a 'Mode: Academic' line and the words left this month.

positive.prompt: How many Akmon words do I have left this month?
positive.expected_behavior: get_account_status returns the words left this month for the signed-in account (and the date they reset). The assistant reports it. No text is rewritten.

negative.description: Translation is not an Akmon function. Akmon is not called; the assistant translates the paragraph itself.
negative.prompt: Translate this paragraph into French: Our team will meet next Tuesday at 10 a.m. to review the quarterly results and plan the next steps for the product launch.

negative.description: Summarizing is not an Akmon function. Akmon is not called; the assistant writes the three-bullet summary itself.
negative.prompt: Summarize this article in three bullets: Cities around the world are adding more bike lanes to reduce traffic and pollution. Early data shows that protected lanes increase the number of people who cycle to work, especially women and older riders. Local shops near new lanes often report steady or higher sales, even when some parking spaces are removed. Critics say the lanes can slow down buses and delivery trucks, so planners are testing shared loading zones and better signal timing.

negative.description: Grammar and typo correction is not an Akmon function (Akmon rewrites style, not spelling). Akmon is not called; the assistant fixes the sentence itself.
negative.prompt: Fix the grammar and typos in this sentence: Their going to the libary tomorow to finsh there project.
